coverage_assessment: 42 actual captured open-web searches produced 805 ordered result headers across French- and English-language general, weekly-window, sector, regional and retrospective queries. Four current-unit body opens and zero prior-unit-only consultations are recorded; there are four provisional event candidates, all pending the 50-person threshold. Thirty cards remain search-only and one is blocked. Results do not establish a complete archive search; LexisNexis and systematic newspaper archives were unavailable, local-language coverage was limited, event endings and adjacent-month continuity remain open, and the official baseline gate is pending.
